profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer  - Retired!
profile.summary:
Software designer with extensive experience in object oriented design. Real-time multi-threaded Java programming. Experience integrating messaging APIs in complex systems, persistence framework/JDBC interface. 
Languages: Java, JavaScript, JSON, XML, XSD, C#, C, Perl
Tools: Eclipse, Golang, JIRA, MySQL, TimesTen, Oracle, GitHub, JUnit, Ant, Maven, Wireshark, SVN, ClearCase
Operating Systems: Windows, macOS, and Linux
Protocol: TCP/IP, HTTP, SSL, SSH, SIP, ISDN, CCS7
DevOps: Jenkins, Docker, VirtualBox, VMWare, AWS
Learning: Python, PHP, Go

positions.title: Happily Retired!
positions.description:
The world's longest "BRB" starts now
 Deployed best update: Retirement 1.0. No more code reviews, no more sprint planning, and absolutely zero legacy code to fix. . .  Lazy mode: On
now where is my coffee!?   :-)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Service Development at Cisco
positions.description: Multi-table database access and provisioning API interface development for Cisco’s Webex WxCAS application server. OCI-P persistence XSD schema API design to manage and configure service data. Multi-layered architecture including command validation, transaction processing, database access encapsulation, and persistence framework/JDBC interface. Data model solutions design and implementation via SQL and Perl scripting for new services and features. Responsible for feature management, overall design, documentation, implementation, testing, and support.
positions.insights: Skills: Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) · OCI-P persistence schema API

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Service Development
positions.description: Software Engineer developing real-time multi-threaded Object Oriented Architectures.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Accelerated Service Development and Support
positions.description: Software Engineer developing real-time multi-threaded Object Oriented Architectures.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer, SIP Core Dev
positions.description: SIP-based VoIP software applications developer and team leader. Senior designer responsible for developing standards-based customer solutions, application feature development, customer support, and documentation. Team leader responsible for project management, design, documentation, and implementation by local and multi-site offshore team members.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer, SIP Clients
positions.description: Design, development, and delivery of Nortel's SIP VoIP desktop multimedia communications client. SIP Client feature implementation for Java and C++ based clients. GUI enhancements, advanced services, graphics design, and documentation. Web services server side and Java Server Pages client development.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, CS3K
positions.description: Developed ISDN NI-2 and U-449 PRI protocol variants for CS 3000 Softswitch product.  Implemented new Java object feature code for processing ISDN layer 3 protocol messaging. CS 3000 Softswitch PRI design team leader responsible for feature project management and delegation of resources. Successfully completed ahead of schedule.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Carrier AIN 0.2
positions.description: Carrier AIN 0.2 software developer to provide an overall intelligent network strategy. Extensive use of object oriented analysis and design to deliver a new strategic framework which allows customers to migrate centralized offboard solutions for IXC (Inter-eXchange-Carrier) feature offerings.

positions.title: MCI Verification Office Support
positions.description: MCI VO team provides the front line support to newly released network switching software and hardware to MCI customer's live network. Support work includes resolution of software problems requiring data gathering, analysis, debugging,  patching, and sourcing solutions.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Dallas - Erik Jonsson School of Engineering and Computer Science
